summary: Government-hosted EY report estimates around 66,000 gaming professionals, while a 2025 Primus report says 130,000 in more than 1,900 gaming companies. Their observation dates and gaming/RMG boundaries are not sufficiently defined for a national core comparison; no synthetic trend is created.

observations.notes: Report calls this current employment; adjacent 2024 gamer statistic does not establish employment observation year.
1.3 lakh converted to 130,000; observation date unstated.

limitations: India reporting often combines video games, online real-money gaming, esports and wider AVGC.
66,000 and 130,000 estimates conflict; dates and worker definitions do not allow reconciliation.
Forecasts of 250,000 jobs and association vision of 500,000+ jobs are not employment observations.
No verified national contractor or foreign-national proportion.
